sourceProvenance.suggestedAlt: A cat and dog resting peacefully together in a warm modern living room with natural side light.
sourceProvenance.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: high-resolution wide website hero photography source for responsive desktop, miniapp, and social crops
Primary request: Create a premium but authentic lifestyle photograph of a real domestic cat and a real dog calmly resting together in a modern warm home.
Scene/backdrop: Quiet contemporary living room with natural side light, subtle pale wood grain, warm off-white woven fabric, and restrained small blue (#4A6CF7) and mint (#5BC8AF) decor accents. Everyday realism, uncluttered, safe after-care feeling.
Subject: One anatomically correct real cat and one anatomically correct real dog, relaxed and peaceful, natural fur and posture, both fully visible enough to crop safely.
Style/medium: Photorealistic natural editorial lifestyle photography, candid rather than staged, realistic fur and fabric texture, restrained premium color grading, no glossy CGI look.
Composition/framing: Extra-wide horizontal 16:9 composition. Keep the entire leftmost 40% completely clean as a quiet copy zone: only a softly lit plain warm off-white wall or extremely subtle unfocused neutral surface, with no pets, furniture edges, plants, decor, shadows, high-contrast lines, or objects. Place both animals and every meaningful scene detail entirely within the right 55%, with comfortable breathing room from the top, right, and bottom crop edges. Keep the central 5% as a gentle visual transition.
Lighting/mood: Soft natural side light, calm, reassuring, warm, trustworthy.
Text: none.
Constraints: No people. Exactly one cat and one dog. Correct anatomy, natural paws and limbs, consistent light and reflections. The left copy zone must remain visually empty and low contrast. No key content near crop edges. Palette accents should be subtle, never saturated.
Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, pseudo-text, interface, button, logo, brand mark, watermark, clinic, veterinary office, medical equipment, cage, kennel, cartoon, illustration, 3D render, duplicated animals, duplicated limbs, malformed paws, extra tails, inconsistent reflections, dramatic saturation or cinematic effects.

sourceProvenance.suggestedAlt: A cat beside a tidy home feeding station with fresh water, measured food, and a blank service-record device.
sourceProvenance.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: high-resolution wide website hero photography source for responsive desktop, miniapp, and social crops
Primary request: Create an authentic, tidy home pet-care scene centered on a well-kept feeding station and a real cat nearby, suggesting reliable professional-quality daily care without looking clinical.
Scene/backdrop: Warm modern home dining or kitchen corner with pale wood and soft neutral plaster, a clean ceramic fresh-water bowl, a separate ceramic bowl holding a modest measured portion of dry food, and one plain phone-shaped service-record prop. The phone-shaped prop must have a dark blank unlit screen with absolutely no visible interface, icons, letters, numbers, or marks.
Subject: Exactly one anatomically correct real cat, calm and attentive near the feeding station; natural posture and fur.
Style/medium: Photorealistic natural editorial home-care photography, candid and credible, real ceramic, wood, water, fur, and fabric textures, restrained premium color grading.
Composition/framing: Extra-wide horizontal 16:9 composition. Place the cat, feeding bowls, measured food, fresh water, phone-shaped prop, and every meaningful object entirely within the left 55%, all with comfortable breathing room from the left, top, and bottom crop edges. Keep the entire rightmost 40% completely clean as a quiet copy zone: only a softly lit plain warm off-white wall or very subtle neutral blur, with no cat, furniture edges, bowls, props, plants, decor, shadows, high-contrast lines, or objects. Keep the central 5% as a gentle transition. Make the bowls and cat readable after responsive crops.
Lighting/mood: Natural morning window light, clean, reassuring, organized, warm but not orange.
Color palette: Mostly warm neutrals with restrained small blue (#4A6CF7) and mint (#5BC8AF) accents; never strongly saturated.
Text: none.
Constraints: No people. Correct cat anatomy, natural paws and tail, coherent perspective, consistent light and reflections. Right copy zone visually empty and low contrast. No key detail near crop edges. The blank phone-shaped prop is secondary and subtle.
Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, pseudo-text, readable interface, icons, logo, brand mark, watermark, buttons, medical equipment, medicine, veterinary office, clinic, cage, kennel, cartoon, illustration, 3D render, duplicated cat, duplicated limbs, malformed paws, extra tail, floating objects, impossible bowl reflections, strong saturation, dramatic commercial effects.

sourceProvenance.suggestedAlt: A cat and dog sharing a relaxed, affectionate moment in a warm sunlit living room.
sourceProvenance.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: high-resolution wide website hero photography source for responsive desktop, miniapp, and social crops
Primary request: Create an editorial lifestyle photograph of a real domestic cat and a real dog sharing a relaxed, quietly affectionate sunlit living-room moment that communicates companionship and community.
Scene/backdrop: Welcoming lived-in modern living room with warm off-white surfaces, subtle natural wood and woven fabric, soft home details that imply human care without showing any person. Include restrained tiny blue (#4A6CF7), mint (#5BC8AF), and amber (#F6B343) decor accents only within the subject side.
Subject: Exactly one anatomically correct real cat and one anatomically correct real dog, naturally comfortable beside each other, with a gentle candid interaction such as relaxed eye contact or resting shoulder-to-shoulder. Natural fur, paws, limbs, ears, and tails.
Style/medium: Photorealistic natural editorial lifestyle photography, human-centered warmth without people, authentic texture and slight everyday imperfection, not posed stock photography, restrained premium color grade.
Composition/framing: Extra-wide horizontal 16:9 composition. Keep the entire leftmost 40% completely clean as a quiet copy zone: only a softly sunlit plain warm off-white wall or very subtle neutral blur, with no pets, furniture edges, plants, decor, shadows, high-contrast lines, or objects. Place both animals and all meaningful living-room details entirely within the right 55%, with comfortable breathing room from top, right, and bottom crop edges. Keep the central 5% as a soft visual transition. Preserve both animals clearly through responsive crops.
Lighting/mood: Natural late-morning sunlight softened through a window, serene, sociable, warm, optimistic, emotionally genuine; avoid dramatic golden-orange grading.
Text: none.
Constraints: No people. Exactly one cat and one dog. Correct anatomy, coherent perspective, consistent light and reflections. Left copy zone visually empty and low contrast. No key content near crop edges. Blue, mint, and amber accents must remain subtle and restrained.
Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, pseudo-text, interface, button, logo, brand mark, watermark, clinic, veterinary office, medical equipment, cage, kennel, cartoon, illustration, 3D render, duplicated animals, duplicated limbs, malformed paws, extra tails, inconsistent reflections, strong saturation, forced poses, glossy stock-photo look, dramatic cinematic effects.
